spans.s:
बृबदुक्थ बृबद्-उक्थ, अस्, m., Ved. an
epithet of Indra, (according to Yāska = either म-
हद्-उक्थ, ‘highly lauded,’ or वक्तव्यम् अस्मा
उक्थम्, ‘one to whom praise is to be ascribed.’)

बृबु बृबु, उस्, m., Ved., N. of a man,
(according to Sāy. he was the carpenter of the Paṇis.)

बृबूक बृबूक, अम्, n., Ved. (according to
Yāska) water; (perhaps an adj.)
